The plate is about 355 px across in the image. If it is a 26 cm dinner plate, that is roughly 13.7 px per cm. The food item is about 190 px wide, so about 13-14 cm.

It looks like a pupusa or a stuffed flatbread topped with curtido (cabbage slaw). A 13 cm pupusa weighs about 120 g and has roughly 250 kcal. The slaw on top adds about 30 g and 15 kcal.

That gives a total of about 150 g and about 270 kcal.
